Company: Celoxis

Location: Pune

Qualification: MBA Finance (Completed)

Experience: Intern

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in day-to-day accounting and finance activities.
• Maintain accounting entries and financial records in Tally.
• Support invoice processing, billing, and payment tracking.
• Assist in bank reconciliation and expense management.
• Maintain financial documentation and reports.
• Support basic GST, TDS, and accounting-related activities.

Required Skills
• Basic knowledge of Tally and Accounting Principles.
• Understanding of debit, credit, journal entries, and ledger accounts.
• Basic proficiency in MS Excel.
• Good numerical and analytical skills.
• Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

Ideal Candidate: An enthusiastic MBA Finance student with basic knowledge of Tally and accounting, eager to gain practical experience in corporate finance and accounting operations.

Role Purpose
• We are seeking a talented and motivated Accountant to take on a new Accounting Manager role in our Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune. This is a key role within the Finance function, responsible for setting up and delivering high-quality accounting and assurance activities to financial controllers and accountants in Europe and across EXA Infrastructure’s footprint.

The role will also seek to automate manual process and support the re-implementation of the Oracle ERP in 2026.

Main Responsibilities
• Establish, lead, and develop a General Ledger (GL) accounting team of 4+ within the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune
• Deliver high-quality accounting services and assurance support to financial controllers and accounting teams across EXA Infrastructure’s European and global footprint.
• Own and oversee accurate and timely month-end close processes, ensuring adherence to group timetables and quality standards.
• Ensure completion and review of robust balance sheet reconciliations, maintaining strong controls and audit-ready documentation.
• Safeguard the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the Group’s financial records and reporting.
• Act as a key point of contact for accounting queries, providing technical guidance and support to internal stakeholders.
• Drive standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement of accounting processes, reducing manual effort and operational risk.
• Support and contribute to the re-implementation of the Oracle ERP system ongoing for 2026.
• Partner closely with Finance, Tax, Treasury, and Audit teams to ensure alignment and effective financial control.
• Support internal and external audit processes, ensuring timely resolution of findings and implementation of improvements.
• Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and documentation in line with Group standards.
• Coach, mentor, and develop team members, promoting a culture of learning, accountability, and high performance.
• Prepare the reconciliation of management reporting v/s IFRS results for cost of sales and SG&A

Individual Profile
• Qualified and experienced Chartered accountant with strong technical accounting knowledge and minimum 6 years of experience
• Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing General Ledger (GL) accounting teams.
• Hands-on approach to delivering high-quality accounting outputs, including month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Strong attention to detail with a robust financial control and assurance mindset
• Experience working within a Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) or shared services environment.
• Ability to partner effectively with financial controllers and accountants across multiple geographies.
• Comfortable operating in a complex, international organisation with European and global stakeholders
• Demonstrated commitment to maintaining the accuracy and integrity of group financial reporting.
• Proactive in identifying opportunities to automate, standardise, and improve manual accounting processes.
• Experience with ERP systems, ideally Oracle, and exposure to system implementations or re-implementations
• Strong leadership and people management skills, with a passion for mentoring and developing junior team members.
• Collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to grow within a supportive, learning-focused environment.

Our working environment

We are committed to working in the location where we do our best work. As a small and growing company with great offices in great locations, most employees will aim to be in the office 3 days a week and 2 days working from home/ other locations.

Here at EXA, we believe the future includes everyone, we are open to all applications to create an environment and culture that includes one and all. We are a proud global community that wants to drive diversity of thought though our employees and culture. We want you to come as you and make yourself and EXA successful.

Dispatch Network is Looking for:

Job Title: Accounting & Finance Manager

Location: Pune, India (On-site)

Type: Full-Time

Experience: 8-10 years

Reports To: CEO & CFO

About Dispatch Network

Dispatch Network is rebuilding last-mile logistics infrastructure in India from the ground up using technology and AI-powered optimization to drive efficiency and earnings for delivery partners. We operate across food delivery, quick commerce, grocery, ecommerce, and pharma — serving both B2B clients and B2C consumers. We're scaling rapidly, and with growth comes operational and financial complexity. This role demands a finance professional who is obsessed with systems and diligent

execution — someone who thrives in building financial processes from scratch and maintaining rigor at scale.

The Opportunity

As Accounts & Finance Manager, you will be shaping our financial systems and operations. You'll own the financial backbone of Dispatch Network — from the moment money enters (client receivables) to how it flows out (partner payables), and everything in between. Your role bridges finance strategy, operational execution, and compliance. This is not a transactional accounting role. You will build financial and cashflow strategies, create models and plans, support the accounting and finance team, and actively participate in negotiations with clients, vendors, and service providers. You'll identify cost management opportunities, assess financial risks, and develop mitigation plans daily.

Primary Responsibilities

Financial Operations & Cash Flow Management
• Own accounts receivable (AR): invoice tracking, collections, reconciliation, and DSO optimization across food delivery, quick commerce, grocery, ecommerce, and pharma clients.
• Own accounts payable (AP): manage timely and accurate payouts to delivery partners, vendors, and service providers while maintaining strong vendor relationships.
• Manage consolidated cash flow forecasting and planning to ensure liquidity across all business channels.
• Track and optimize working capital cycles—critical in a multi-channel logistics business.
• Conduct daily/weekly bank reconciliations and treasury management.

Accounting & Compliance
• Manage complete accounting operations: journal entries, ledger maintenance, bank reconciliations, and financial statement preparation (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).
• Ensure GST compliance and timely GST returns filing
• Handle TDS compliance and timely TDS return filing (TDS certificates, monthly returns).
• Manage statutory compliance: PT (Professional Tax), PF (Provident Fund), ESIC (Employee State Insurance Code), and other regulatory filings.
• Build and document financial SOPs and accounting systems to ensure consistency and auditability.
• Prepare compliant financial statements and supporting schedules for internal use and external stakeholders.
• Support internal and external audits, identifying and resolving compliance gaps proactively.

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
• Create and maintain financial models for budgeting, revenue forecasting, and cost projections across channels.
• Develop monthly, quarterly, and annual investor update MIS: KPIs, financial dashboards, and commentary.
• Support cost control initiatives and spend optimization across operations.
• Analyze unit economics by channel and customer segment; provide actionable insights to operations and product teams.
• Track and forecast key financial metrics: contribution margin, and blended unit economics.

Payroll & HR Finance
• Manage complete payroll operations: salary processing, statutory deductions, and timely disbursement.
• Ensure accurate PF, ESIC, and TDS calculations and compliance.
• Prepare payroll registers and reconciliation.

Systems & Process Design
• Design and build accounting workflows that align financial processes with operations, product, and logistics workflows.
• Implement tools and systems for financial tracking, reporting, and controls (ERP/accounting software).
• Create dashboards and reports for finance, operations, and executive teams.
• Document all financial processes, controls, and SOP documentation for scalability.

Stakeholder Management
• Collaborate with Operations and Product teams to align financial planning with business initiatives.
• Lead negotiations with clients on payment terms and contracts.
• Manage vendor negotiations on payment terms and cost structures.
• Communicate financial performance and insights to founders, investors, and board members.

Who You Are

Mindset & Approach
• Systems-obsessed: You believe good systems are the foundation of scaling businesses. You naturally think in processes, controls, and documentation.
• Diligent & meticulous: You are obsessed with accuracy and detail. Errors in finance compound, and you understand this deeply. You triple-check reconciliations and chase down discrepancies.
• Entrepreneurial: You don't just execute tasks—you think strategically about financial management. You identify problems proactively and propose solutions. You take ownership.
• Biased toward action: You thrive in early-stage environments where financial processes don't exist yet. You build them. You don't wait for perfect data; you work with what's available, document assumptions, and iterate.
• Numbers-driven: You communicate with data. You can spot anomalies in financial data and dig into root causes.

Experience & Skills
• 8-10 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, or financial operations roles.
• Experience in logistics, 3PL, last-mile delivery, or hyperlocal services (highly preferred) — you understand the operational complexity and cash flow dynamics of this sector.
• Proficiency in MS Excel at an advanced level (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis, dashboarding).
• Strong grasp of Indian compliance requirements: GST, TDS, PT, PF, ESIC, and statutory filings. You've filed these returns yourself or supervised the filings.
• Accounting software experience
• Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent professional qualification like CA in progress or completed).

Demonstrated Competencies
• Excellent analytical skills and ability to synthesize large datasets into actionable insights.
• Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to see the bigger financial picture.
• Excellent communication skills: ability to translate financial concepts for non-finance stakeholders (operations, product, founders).
• Stakeholder management: ability to negotiate and build relationships with clients, vendors, and team members.
• Problem-solving mindset: you ask 'why' and dig into root causes when something doesn't add up.
• Comfort with ambiguity: in early-stage companies, financial processes evolve. You adapt and document as you go.

Why This Role Matters

In a logistics business operating across multiple channels (food, quick commerce, grocery, ecommerce, pharma), financial complexity emerges quickly:
• Multi-entity cash flows: Money flows in from diverse clients, flows out to thousands of delivery partners and vendors. You ensure zero leakage.
• Regulatory complexity: Each channel may have different GST, TDS, or operational requirements. Your compliance discipline protects the company.
• Unit economics at scale: As we grow across geographies, the ability to track unit economics by channel, city, and customer segment becomes critical for capital allocation decisions.
• Investor relations: Our investors expect rigorous, timely, and transparent financial reporting. You are the custodian of that trust.
• Operational efficiency: By collaborating with ops and product teams, you help optimize cost structures and identify profitability levers.

This role is foundational to Dispatch Network's ability to scale efficiently and confidently.

What You Will Get
• Ownership: You will own the entire finance function at a fast-growing logistics tech company. Your systems and processes directly enable growth.
• Visibility & impact: You report to the founding team. Your insights directly inform strategic decisions.
• Complexity & growth: You'll be exposed to complex financial workflows spanning operations, logistics, technology, and multi-channel business models.
• Scalability: As we grow from Pune to multiple cities and channels, your systems and team will scale. You'll build the foundation that supports that growth.
• Team & culture: You'll join a high-ownership, fast-moving team obsessed with systems and execution. We value diligence and thoughtfulness.
• Learning: You'll work on real, mission-critical financial challenges—cash flow optimization, cost management, risk assessment, and investor relations.

Success Criteria (First 3 Months)
• Week 1: Comprehensive audit of existing financial processes, accounts, and compliance status. Identify gaps and create remediation plan.
• Month 1: Build accounting SOPs (AR, AP, payroll, reconciliation). Implement accounting software.
• Month 2: Complete compliance audit;
• Month 3: Develop financial dashboards and MIS; deliver the first investor update package. Build relationships with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
• Ongoing: Maintain 100% compliance and zero audit findings. Deliver accurate, timely monthly financial statements and cash flow forecasts.

ABOUT CENCORA & ABFINCO

ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts. Reporting to the Treasury Accounting Lead, the role will also strengthen controls, reporting and processes as the in-house treasury accounting function develops.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Treasury Accounting and Close

· Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.

· Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.

· Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.

· Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.

· Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

Intercompany Loans and Cash

· Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.

· Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.

· Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

Controls and Systems

· Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.

· Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.

· Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

Team and Stakeholder Support

· Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.

· Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.

PROFILE & SKILLS

Essential

· Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant, ACCA or equivalent finance qualification, with 4–7 years of relevant treasury accounting experience.

· Practical experience of month-end close, reconciliations, FX accounting and intercompany accounting.

· Hands-on experience with an ERP or treasury management system; SAP or Kyriba exposure is preferred.

Strong analytical, reconciliation and control skills, with attention to detail in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

· Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across Treasury, Finance, Tax, Legal and IT.
